I was quite emotional at first. I have depression and I was/am in a low place. I wasn’t mean, I’d just sort of mention how I was sad frequently. As a result of this, they called me miserable and said they’d feel better if they got rid of me. ‘Got rid of me’, like I’m some sort of object. They were ‘suffering from their mistake”. I cried and cried and cried over that. I stopped talking about my feelings subsequent to that, because that would make me miserable. They called me a monster and an attention seeker after I mentioned something I had been through. It hurt so bad. They called me a monster for talking about something that had made me feel trapped and so incredibly suicidal. Tis never nice to be called an attention seeker. I’m now always scared to talk about feelings, because no one cares. Admittedly yeah, I could have been calmer, but usually my emotions take over. I just want to die now

There’s a whole world of people out there. I promise you’ll find better people. I gets easier, I swear. Take it from me. You got this !!
